name: Colosseum and Roman Forum Tour
description: A guided tour through the ancient amphitheater and adjacent ruins of the Roman Forum.

name: Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel
description: A skip-the-line tour through the Vatican's art collections, ending at Michelangelo's Sistine Chapel ceiling.

name: Trastevere Evening Walk
description: A self-guided evening stroll through a cobblestone neighborhood known for its narrow streets and lively piazzas.

name: Villa Borghese Gardens
description: A large landscaped park with lake views, sculpture-lined paths, and a panoramic terrace over the city.

name: Trevi Fountain and Spanish Steps Walk
description: A self-guided walking route past two of Rome's most iconic landmarks, best visited early morning or evening.
